comparison.objective: Use a soldering iron to press a brass heat-set insert straight and flush into a printed bracket.
comparison.physical_skill: Coaxial heated pressing with depth and tilt regulation; no hammering, fracture, or recovery of separated tangs.
comparison.success_condition: Insert ends straight and flush, and the iron is withdrawn; over-depth or tilted seating fails. Exact tolerances and thermal model details are absent.
comparison.reason: This is the closest insert-related record, but it tests installing and seating an insert through controlled heating and axial motion; the candidate begins with retained inserts and tests subsequent notch fracture, coil preservation, and debris recovery.
